children: First Community entered into a merger agreement to acquire Main Street Financial Services in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $243 million. Main Street shareholders will receive 0.6174 First Community shares for each share they own, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares; the companies expect the deal to close early in the second quarter of 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The acquisition expands First Community's banking presence in east central Ohio and northern West Virginia.
: Until closing or termination; expected to close early in Q2 2027
